Provenance and licence of the two RAW heads in this folder (L7 of the T24 release review).

canon_5dm3.head.cr2: the first 262144 bytes (256 KB) of
  https://raw.pixls.us/getfile.php/773/nice/Canon%20-%20EOS%205D%20Mark%20III%20-%20sRAW2%20(sRAW).CR2
  (Canon EOS 5D Mark III, sRAW2; raw.pixls.us repository listing: uploaded 2017-01-05)
  sha256 of the FULL source file: a79065e78a6c5bdbc8726e786ade02d54a7d496cc3cb4504d804c924a3d999da
  sha256 of the 256 KB head as stored: dc5356eec5118e1f69fee4a8a59739f00a323601cf637255adad237dda100a7a

sony_a7m3.head.arw: the first 262144 bytes (256 KB) of
  https://raw.pixls.us/getfile.php/2414/nice/Sony%20-%20ILCE-7M3%20-%2014bit%2014bit%20compressed%20(3:2).ARW
  (Sony ILCE-7M3 (A7 III), 14-bit compressed; uploaded 2018-03-14)
  sha256 of the FULL source file: 250784580ea527442c09004417bb0eead484f2bf3ee8f9121a776ac65bb50d0f
  sha256 of the 256 KB head as stored: 2847f89ba351d258070b29b838952a3797b4abe3eb354134ed6a4008b8f465da

Licence: CC0 1.0 / public domain. raw.pixls.us accepts only samples whose uploader releases them
under CC0, and its per-sample licence column in the repository listing
(https://raw.pixls.us/json/getrepository.php?set=all, checked 2026-11-09) shows "Creative Commons 0 -
Public Domain" for both files above. The source of each head was re-established on 2026-11-09 by
downloading the candidate samples of these two camera models and comparing the first 256 KB byte for
byte with the stored heads. The serial numbers and the artist tag in their EXIF belong to the
uploaders, not to the ShotSieve authors. The files are data only; they are parsed by
tests/test_makernotes.py, never executed.
